svg.title: MacLink connection selection
svg.desc: Automatic WebRTC selection, one optional TURN TLS-only retry, then a connection failure notice if no route works.

path.aria-label: Connect with WebRTC, directly or via TURN.
Automatic mode selects an available route; connection success depends on network policy.
Without configured TURN credentials, automatic mode skips stage 02.
The session ends with an error.
The Mac must still be reachable.
A proxy, firewall or managed browser may still block TURN. This setting does not bypass network policy.
A faster connection is possible only when a compatible route is available.
